children.value: > Fact From Story: SBF has pleaded not-guilty to some seven charges of fraud and conspiracy.

> > Fact From Story: The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy.
> > > Fact From Story: SBF faces seven federal charges, including wire fraud, securities fraud and money laundering, that could put him in prison for the rest of his life.
> > > Fact From Story: SBF is in court for alleged fraud and money laundering while leading crypto exchange FTX and sister company Alameda.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People plead not guilty when they deny committing a crime.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A trial is a formal examination of evidence before a judge, and typically before a jury, in order to decide guilt or innocence in a case of criminal or civil proceedings.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A trial is held to determine the guilt or innocence of someone charged with a crime.
